author: Bobby Grayson
description: docs/readiness.md now ends the planning section with the ten nearest untranslatable modules. Distance 1: Loom.LSP.ConfigListener (one blocker, one call into Loom.LSP.Supervisor). Distance 2: BobsBroadcastWeb.StreamController, EnsembleWeb.LogsLive, Loom.Session.Architect, Loom.Tools.Shell, LoomWeb.CostDashboardLive, EnsembleWeb.DecisionGraphLive. Distance 3: Ensemble.AI.TextGenerator, BobsBroadcastWeb.RadioLive, Ensemble.IssueOrchestrator. Four of the top seven share one family: 'no @type state and no init/1 to infer one from' -- untyped mode needs an init/1 to read the state literal from, and these modules have none (init is a callback of a LiveView or the state comes from somewhere else). The other recurring one, 'receive not the whole body of a one-argument def', is a receive nested inside a larger function. Two families together would take the count from 1 translatable module to something like 5.
title: Planning input for round 8, from the new closest-to-translatable table
